cause_quote: The introducing diff rendered report prose in `<div class="deep-research-report">` and styled it with `.deep-research-report { white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.65; }`, leaving it to inherit the app body's antialiased font smoothing.
user_saw: Deep Research report text in the Control UI side panel looked thin on macOS.
summary: The fix sets platform-default font smoothing on Deep Research report prose, including inline citations.
reasoning: I checked the pane's introducing diff and confirmed its parent already set `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased` on `body`. The report inherited that setting from its first release, and the path history shows no font-smoothing changes in either stylesheet before this fix.
